problems.evidence_sentence: In contrast, our proposed E.M.Ground models the holistic query event by a special token <evt>, which preserves the semantic continuity and integrity of the event, thus achieving better and stable performances on videos of varying lengths. grounding accuracy is constrained by the limited numerical reasoning ability of current LLMs [32], [33].

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
